summary_en: Nihon Falcom raised its full-year dividend forecast to 60 yen per share, consisting of 30 yen ordinary dividend (20 yen increase) and 30 yen special commemorative dividend for the Trails series reaching 10 million units sold worldwide.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase in Ordinary Dividend and Special Commemorative Dividend for Trails Series Reaching 10 Million Units Sold)
translation_en_brief: Nihon Falcom announced a revision to its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending September 2026. The ordinary dividend per share was increased by 20 yen to 30 yen, reflecting the company's strong earnings performance which is expected to set a new record high for the period. In addition to the ordinary dividend, the company plans to propose a special commemorative dividend of 30 yen per share at the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for December 2026, celebrating the worldwide cumulative sales of the Trails video game series reaching 10 million units. This milestone represents a significant achievement for the company's flagship franchise. The total dividend per share for the fiscal year is projected at 60 yen, comprising 30 yen in ordinary dividend and 30 yen in special commemorative dividend, compared to the previous forecast of 20 yen per share (10 yen ordinary dividend and 10 yen commemorative dividend) for the same period in the prior fiscal year.
